description: Google Trends related queries for a keyword. Returns the searches people run alongside a keyword in a given country: top queries scored 0-100 relative to each other, and rising queries with their percentage growth. Google Trends keyword expansion for SEO keyword research, content planning, and spotting breakout search demand early. [$0.03/call]. Params — keyword: the search term; geo: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP (213 countries supported); timeframe: time window. Each response reports its own bucket size in `granularity`: past_30_days and past_90_days return a daily series, past_12_months and past_5_years weekly, windows under a day hourly (2004_present|past_12_months|past_30_days|past_4_hours|past_5_years|past_7_days|past_90_days|past_day|past_hour) Example params: {'keyword': 'bitcoin', 'geo': 'US'}
name: related_queries
